notes: THE OFFICE LINE ON THE FORM IS BLANK - the cover's 'Office' box is empty (the chunk file's office column is likewise empty, so the two agree). This is one of the county's known blank-office filings, an honest state, not a misread; the money is transcribed normally and the filing's scope cannot be settled from the office line. Candidate 'Allison Goulais' matches the chunk. Report type marked 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; amendment = No. Date of Report 10.28.2024 on the cover and all footers; the chunk file dates the row 2024-11-01, which the FORM does not say. ODDITY, VERBATIM AND UNRESOLVED: Schedule B repeats the first three Schedule A lines as EXPENDITURES - same dates, same names (Shannon Rhodes, Cache Democrats, Travis Marble), same amounts (170.00 / 450.00 / 600.00), with purposes 'Filing Fee', 'Yard signs', 'Website' added. That is what the filer wrote and it is what both printed totals and the balance chain are built on, so it is transcribed verbatim on both sides; whether the filer meant three distinct payees is not decidable from the document. Contributor street addresses and a PO box are printed in the clear on this form and were discarded at read time - only city/state are emitted. Date format is MM.DD.YYYY, fixed by the report's own date '10.28.2024' (month 10, day 28).
